error_connect: The connection failed. Check the details and try again.
welcome_desc: Hontrio creates Google Shopping campaigns for your products and optimizes them every day.
store_desc: Hontrio reads your products and orders to see what sells. It never changes anything in your store.
edinio_desc: Approve access in your Edinio account, then come back here. There’s no key to copy.
woo_tut_1_desc: Go to your store’s address followed by /wp-admin and sign in as an administrator.
woo_tut_2_title: WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API keys
woo_tut_2_desc: In the side menu, open WooCommerce → Settings, then the “Advanced” tab and the “REST API keys” section.
woo_tut_3_desc: Click “Create an API key”, enter “Hontrio” as the description and choose “Read” under Permissions. Then click “Generate API key”.
woo_tut_4_desc: Copy the “Consumer key” (it starts with ck_) and the “Consumer secret” (it starts with cs_) into the fields below. The secret isn’t shown again once you leave the page.
shopify_desc: Enter your store’s domain and approve access in Shopify. There’s no key to copy.
google_desc: Hontrio creates and manages the campaigns in your Google Ads account.
google_store_account: Campaigns for {{store}} will run in the {{account}} account.
google_choose_later_one: We found {{count}} Google Ads account. You can choose the store’s account in Settings → Integrations.
google_choose_later_other: We found {{count}} Google Ads accounts. You can choose the store’s account in Settings → Integrations.
done_desc: The Overview lists the steps left before your first campaign, such as Merchant Center and the purchase conversion.
done_desc_partial: You can connect what you skipped at any time. The Overview lists every step left before your first campaign.
intro_store_desc: You’ll need admin access to your store.
intro_google_desc: You’ll need a Google Ads account. If you don’t have one, you can create it on the spot.
woo_form_desc: You create a read-only REST API key in WooCommerce and paste it below.
store_syncing_desc: We’re syncing your products and orders. You can continue the setup in the meantime.
store_synced_desc: Your products and orders are synced. We’ll keep them up to date from now on.
visual_0_title: Your products show up in Google searches.
visual_0_desc: Each ad shows the product’s photo and price.
visual_1_title: We start with what you already sell.
visual_1_desc: Your sales show which products are worth promoting.
visual_2_title: Your Google Ads account stays yours.
visual_2_desc: The campaigns appear in Google Ads like any others.
visual_3_title: Your first campaign starts when you decide.
visual_3_desc: You choose the budget at launch, and any increase needs your approval.
